description: This file defines the Language class within the OpenCart system, responsible for managing language text strings, including loading language files, retrieving, setting, and managing language data and cache.

classes.name: Language
classes.description: A class for managing language strings, loading language files, and handling language data within the OpenCart system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Language object with a specific language code.

methods.name: addPath
methods.description: Adds a namespace and directory path for loading language files.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a language string by key, returns the key if not found.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a language string for a given key.

methods.name: all
methods.description: Returns all language data, optionally filtered by a prefix.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a language file, optionally with a prefix and specific language code, and caches the data.
